content: Even though most NLI research has been carried out on English data, an important research trend in recent years has been the application of NLI methods to other languages, as discussed in multilingual-nli. Recent NLI studies on languages other than English include Arabic BIBREF8 and Chinese BIBREF9 , BIBREF10 . To the best of our knowledge, no study has been published on Portuguese and the NLI-PT dataset opens new possibilities of research for Portuguese. In Section "A Baseline for Portuguese NLI" we present the first simple baseline results for this task.
